## Validation

List the checks you ran. Use synthetic screenshots for UI changes.

- [ ] Relevant tests pass; changed Go files are formatted.
- [ ] Documentation reflects changed behavior.
- [ ] No personal usage data, credentials, or generated exports are included.
- [ ] I have read CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md and have the right to submit this work under the MIT license.
- [ ] User-visible changes have an Unreleased changelog entry, or this is not applicable.
